Description: The audit-trail builder marks an operation record accepted when an explicit user acceptance signal is present, but it does not require validation_outcome to show passed schema, constraint, unit, and diff-preview gates. A blocked validation outcome could therefore be preserved as an accepted audit decision unless an external caller prevents it.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: accepted audit records require passed schema/constraint/unit validation, generated diff preview, not_applied application status, and hash-bound diff-preview reference; otherwise AUDIT-VALIDATION-GATES-BLOCKING prevents accepted status.

Description: The audit trail hashes records and references an accepted model state, but accepted operation records are not required to include or verify a current model-state hash. The test fixture leaves required_current_hashes empty, limiting DEL-02-05 reproducibility and stale-review protection.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: accepted audit records require an accepted model-state hash and matching operation required_current_hashes; accepted_model_state_ref carries the hash and stale/missing hashes emit blocking diagnostics.
